title: Surrogate Models for Stochastic Al-Cu Phase-Field Solidification
abstract: arXiv:2611.04695v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Phase-field models resolve microstructural evolution during rapid alloy solidification, but their computational cost limits long trajectories, stochastic ensembles, and studies across process conditions. We compare a deterministic U-Net with conditional flow matching (Flow), conditional diffusion (EDM), and a variance-preserving denoising diffusion bridge (VP-DDBM) for two-dimensional Al-Cu solidification. Given the current phase, concentration, and prescribed temperature fields, each model predicts the subsequent state and is applied autoregressively. At two thermal gradients outside the training range, we compare surrogate rollouts spanning \(48{,}000\) phase-field Euler steps with five phase-field futures generated from a common restart at each gradient. With two network evaluations per transition, Flow achieves the lowest time-averaged fair continuous ranked probability score among the generative surrogates for mean phase, mean C

translated_title: 随机Al-Cu相场凝固的代理模型
translated_abstract: 相场模型能够解析快速合金凝固过程中的微观组织演化，但其计算成本限制了长轨迹模拟、随机系综研究以及跨工艺条件的研究。我们针对二维Al-Cu凝固，比较了确定性U-Net与条件流匹配、条件扩散模型（EDM）以及方差保持去噪扩散桥模型（VP-DDBM）。在给定当前相场、浓度场和规定温度场的情况下，每个模型预测下一时刻的状态，并以自回归方式迭代应用。在两个超出训练范围的热梯度条件下，我们将代理模型跨越48,000个相场欧拉步的推演结果，与在每个梯度下从同一重启点生成的五个相场未来状态进行比较。在每次状态转移仅需两次网络评估的条件下，Flow在各生成式代理模型中，对平均相场、平均浓……
tldr: 该研究系统比较了确定性U-Net、条件流匹配、条件扩散（EDM）和方差保持扩散桥（VP-DDBM）四种代理模型在二维Al-Cu相场凝固模拟中的表现，发现流匹配模型每次转移仅需两次网络评估，即在生成式代理中取得最优的概率预测精度，并可在超出训练范围的热梯度下完成48,000步的长时程自回归推演。
en_tdlr: This study benchmarks deterministic U-Net, conditional flow matching, conditional diffusion (EDM), and a variance-preserving denoising diffusion bridge (VP-DDBM) as surrogates for 2D Al-Cu phase-field solidification, showing that flow matching achieves the lowest time-averaged fair continuous ranked probability score among generative surrogates with only two network evaluations per transition, while enabling autoregressive rollouts spanning 48,000 phase-field Euler steps at thermal gradients outside the training range.
